newsitem.title: USA: ARXA buys interest in two oil properties.
newsitem.headline: ARXA buys interest in two oil properties.

text.p: ARXA International Energy Inc said Tuesday it acquired a 12.5 percent working interest in the Northwest Hackberry Producing Area and a 12.5 percent working interest in the West Hackberry Field, both in Cameron Parish, Louisiana.
ARXA Chief Executive William Bippus, in a telephone interview, declined to name the private oil company that sold the interests.

The acquisitions, made for an undisclosed amount of cash, are in line with ARXA's long-range strategic plan of negotiating acquisitions of oil and gas properties that will immediately increase cash flow, Bippus said.
